mapper.select: SELECT std_cd, aply_bgn_ym, std_nm, std_val, unit_nm, std_desc, changed_by FROM ( SELECT s.std_cd, s.aply_bgn_ym, s.std_nm, s.std_val, s.unit_nm, s.std_desc, CASE WHEN s.mod_user_id IS NULL AND s.reg_user_id = 'SYSTEM' THEN '처음 설정' ELSE COALESCE(u.user_nm, s.mod_user_id, s.reg_user_id) END AS changed_by FROM TB_SY_OPER_STD s LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.user_id = COALESCE(s.mod_user_id, s.reg_user_id) ) v ORDER BY std_cd, aply_bgn_ym
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE TB_SY_OPER_STD, TB_CL_CLOSE IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_OPER_STD (std_cd, aply_bgn_ym, std_nm, std_val, unit_nm, std_desc, reg_user_id, reg_dttm) VALUES (#{standardCode}, #{month}, #{standardName}, #{value}, #{unit}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'admin', clock_timestamp())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_SY_OPER_STD WHERE std_cd=#{standardCode} AND aply_bgn_ym=#{month}
